title: Practice 3: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: The bird picked up the twig with its beak and flew to its nest.
exercises.why: **полетела** — past tense (feminine) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».
exercises.ru: Птица подобрала прутик клювом и ___ к своему гнезду.

exercises.q: Я хочу ___ (слетать — to fly there and back; pf., inf.) на Луну.
exercises.why: **слетать** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I want to go to the moon.

exercises.q: What did you forget in the attic? What the hell made you go there?
exercises.why: **понесло** — past tense (neuter) of понести: the perfective of нести, «set out».
exercises.ru: Что ты забыл на чердаке? Какого лешего тебя туда ___?

exercises.q: Куда вы меня ___ (повести — to lead off, take along; pf., fut. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **поведёте** — future tense (2nd person plural) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Where are you going to take me?

exercises.q: Я хочу ___ (слетать — to fly there and back; pf., inf.) на Марс.
exercises.why: **слетать** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I want to go to Mars.

exercises.q: Позвольте мне ___ (понести — to carry off (on foot); pf., inf.).
exercises.why: **понести** — infinitive, the perfective of нести, «set out».

exercises.q: Куда ты меня ___ (повести — to lead off, take along; pf., fut. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **поведёшь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Where are you going to take me?

exercises.q: Каким поездом ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., fut. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **поедешь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Which train are you going to take?

exercises.q: Возможно, ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 3rd sg.) снег.
exercises.why: **пойдёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Когда он ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 3rd sg.) домой?
exercises.why: **пойдёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Я ___ (понести — to carry off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st sg.) твой чемодан.
exercises.why: **понесу** — future tense (1st person singular) of понести: the perfective of нести, «set out».
exercises.prompt: I'll carry this suitcase for you.

exercises.q: Можно я ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st sg.) погуляю?
exercises.why: **пойду** — future tense (1st person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: May I go out for a walk?

exercises.q: Я ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st sg.) заведу машину.
exercises.why: **пойду** — future tense (1st person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: I'll go and start the car.

exercises.q: Я лучше ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st sg.) поучусь.
exercises.why: **пойду** — future tense (1st person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Хочешь ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., inf.) погулять?
exercises.why: **пойти** — infinitive, the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Do you want to go for a walk?

exercises.q: Хотите ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., inf.) погулять?
exercises.why: **пойти** — infinitive, the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Would you like to go for a walk?

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st sg.) поставлю чайник.
exercises.why: **пойду** — future tense (1st person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: I'll go put the kettle on.

exercises.q: Всё ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., past n. sg.) наперекосяк.
exercises.why: **пошло** — past tense (neuter) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Она должна туда ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., inf.).
exercises.why: **пойти** — infinitive, the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Я хочу ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., inf.) на охоту.
exercises.why: **пойти** — infinitive, the perfective of йти, «set out».
